text:
Date: Announced on 14 March 2025, effective from the start of the 2025-26 season.
Named person: Tobias Verhaegen, Chair of the Halewyn Philharmonic Board, confirmed the appointment.
Figure: Oyelaran signed a four-year contract, with 62 performances scheduled in her first season.
Basis: The report rests on the board's official press release, "Appointment of Music Director," issued after the 13 March board vote.
